title: The Golden Fortress
subtitle: A Puzzle of Shadows in Ancient Walls
summary: When the brilliant detective Feluda finds himself ruminating on the mysteries of geometry, an unusual case soon pulls him into an adventure where logic and observation are key. Ancient secrets, eccentric characters, and hidden dangers await as Feluda and his companions travel to uncover the truth behind the enigmatic Golden Fortress. Dive in and join Feluda on a journey where every clue is a shape waiting to be solved.
